introduction.text: Convex light-curve reconstruction. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: DAMIT shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 110.54 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.57 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). An alternative pole solution remains in the archive. Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation; the grid marks unavailable imagery.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 55.27 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
